commit_message:
tiering: size-aware admission, residency since admission (#24) (#39)

* tiering: max_item_fraction admission, residency from admission (admitted_at), warn once per stuck episode (#24)

* tiering: max_item_fraction on TieredStore (read and write paths), admit signature restored, one release per hot drop (#24)

Review of the #24 change:
- PlacementPolicy.admit back to (key, stats, *, now); max_item_fraction moves to
  TieredStore.__init__ (validated, 0 < x <= 1, default 1.0), applied to read-miss
  admission and write-through; prefetch/local_paths stay exempt.
- admitted_at means 'hot since': _drop_hot records exactly one release per actual
  drop; deletes record only the delete.
- merge_stats takes admitted_at from the log with the latest last_access.
- __getitem__ sizes the value once; admit events carry no size.
- warn-once-per-stuck-episode extracted into a helper.
- Tests: default-policy oversize scenario, write-path oversize, validation,
  compact/reopen and old snapshots, merge_stats, reopen with protection checked.
